source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'TEMP_MIDPLANE' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100

original_test_intent: Verify `TEMP_MIDPLANE` represents the intended midplane thermal sensing point and is human-readable in Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading with the correct value, units, health state and supported thresholds for the platform specification.
original_method: Resolve the stable midplane record and exact assembly/probe location, capture complete read-only raw and unchanged UI fields, and compare them with the approved midplane limits and any non-intrusive time-aligned reference under documented component population, load, fan and airflow state. Preserve logs and chassis configuration.
manual_activity: The platform owner identifies the exact midplane assembly/probe and decides whether acceptance is specification-range/status only or includes an approved non-intrusive reference. Automation can collect the record and both UI paths; a human verifies location/reference interpretation and owns the verdict. No chassis opening or airflow change is implied.
required_inputs: Exact chassis/board/BMC/BIOS and midplane assembly/revision with drawing or sensor map identifying the sensing point
Stable SDR name/number/type/entity/instance and matching Dashboard and Server Health rows
Expected Celsius scaling/rounding, static range or reference delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, unavailable and freshness semantics
Installed component population, system load/power state, fan mode/speeds, panels/ducts and airflow configuration with timestamps
If accuracy is required, an approved non-intrusive calibrated reference, probe placement, calibration validity, combined uncertainty and BMC update-lag rule
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, protected authentication and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or manual method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or system logs; cooling, fan, board and thermal events provide necessary context for the midplane reading.
Do not infer midplane identity from the label. Confirm the assembly revision and probe location; do not substitute a generic chassis midpoint, motherboard outlet, backplane or ambient sensor.

Do not open a cover, remove an air duct or route a reference probe in a way that changes airflow for this passive row. Any intrusive accuracy setup needs a separate approved test plan and restored configuration.
Do not change fan policy, add workload, obstruct airflow, heat the assembly or alter thresholds. Record the existing component population and operating state.

Distinguish static specification-range/status validation from calibrated accuracy. A room reading or neighboring sensor is corroboration only unless the approved correlation and uncertainty are defined.

Do not truncate inventory, expose passwords using `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the unavailable internal Script. Stop without automatic retry on duplicate identity, stale data or raw/UI/reference disagreement.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, midplane assembly/probe map, cooling configuration, client and Script; establish whether the approved criterion is static range or calibrated comparison.
Capture the complete raw/API record and unchanged Dashboard plus Server Health rows with identity, reading, units, supported thresholds, status and timestamps.
Record population/load/fan/panel/airflow state and compare with versioned limits; add only an approved non-intrusive time-aligned reference using the specified uncertainty and lag.
Preserve redacted evidence and logs; perform no clear, chassis/duct/fan/load/environment/threshold change, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact midplane assembly/revision, sensing point and its distinction from motherboard, backplane, inlet and outlet sensors.
Define range/status versus calibrated-accuracy acceptance, thresholds, tolerance, freshness and any safe reference placement, and approve the tool/Script.
Review raw, UI and any reference evidence under the documented cooling state and issue the formal verdict with passive-coverage limitations.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal query may retrieve the named record, but it cannot prove the physical midplane identity, cooling/reference conditions or UI/spec agreement. The fallback is truncated, and the command exposes credentials and assumes cipher support.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve TEMP_MIDPLANE through complete inventory and the approved assembly sensor map, retrieve it with protected read-only access, capture both UI paths and compare against the defined passive range or non-intrusive reference under a documented cooling state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_MIDPLANE, Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, readability/specification Criteria, generic clear text, Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review adds identity/context without editing Master or changing chassis airflow.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate a stable SDR identity and both UI rows with the versioned midplane assembly/probe map, document population/load/fan/panel state, then apply either approved static limits or a non-intrusive synchronized reference and uncertainty model.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact chassis/midplane/cooling configuration and BMC/SDR/WebUI build documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/board/midplane revision, BIOS/BMC/SDR/WebUI, fan policy, management client, optional reference-instrument calibration and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Midplane assembly and sensor-placement drawings, platform thermal/SDR limits, airflow/cooling specification, WebUI schema and Project configuration specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds assembly-level identity, cooling-state evidence and an explicit static-versus-accuracy criterion while keeping the original passive sensor/UI method.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A passive midplane value does not validate temperature distribution across the assembly, response to workload, threshold events, fan-control behavior or protection actions; a static range check is not a calibrated accuracy test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Assembly/probe map, range or reference acceptance, thresholds/freshness, cooling-state record, protected tool or reviewed Script and evidence contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Midplane temperature has spatial gradients and depends on populated cards/drives and airflow; intrusive probe placement can change the quantity being measured, while UI rounding/update delay can cause benign differences.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM telemetry as an approved alternative to ipmitool only with the original method preserved, interface/version and reason recorded, engineer approval and equivalent midplane identity, value, threshold, status and freshness coverage. A backplane, chassis-midpoint, inlet or outlet reading is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/board/BMC/BIOS and midplane assembly/revision identity plus authoritative drawing/photo locating the TEMP_MIDPLANE probe
Complete raw/API record with stable ID, value, units, threshold capabilities/values, status and timestamp
Redacted Dashboard and Server Health evidence mapped to the same record and physical assembly
Component population, system load/power, fan speeds/policy, panel/duct and airflow state with timestamps
Approved static-range comparison or non-intrusive calibrated reference samples with placement, uncertainty and update-lag calculation
Pinned Script/tool security evidence, no-clear/no-write/no-chassis-or-airflow-change/no-retry proof, final cooling/BMC health, limitations and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, UI Procedure and readability/specification Criteria consistently describe a passive midplane temperature display check. Exact assembly, probe location and acceptance mode are missing Project inputs, not contradictory test purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The named midplane sensor and passive validation purpose are clear. Project documentation can provide location, cooling context and criteria, so readiness is pending rather than permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on hybrid classification while separating a static range/status check from calibrated accuracy and preventing an intrusive reference setup from altering airflow.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible but wrongly mapped or stale temperature from being accepted as midplane coverage and prevents an intrusive probe or opened chassis from invalidating the airflow condition being measured.
independent_technical_reasoning: A midplane is a specific interconnect/power assembly, not merely the geometric middle of a chassis. Temperature depends on its component population and the air path. The sensor therefore needs assembly/probe mapping and recorded cooling state. Accuracy comparison, if required, must avoid altering panels or ducts; otherwise the defensible scope is passive range/status and UI consistency only.
